title: Study access after a role change

sections.heading: Lost study access after a role change
sections.text: When a user reports they lost study access after a role change, Tier 1 staff collect the details below and route the request to an authorized administrator. Tier 1 staff do not change roles, grant or restore access, or confirm identity outside the documented verification procedure.

steps.text: Record the synthetic study identifier and the site the user is assigned to.
Record when the role change happened and who requested it, as stated by the user.
An authorized administrator verifies the requester's identity using the documented verification procedure.
An authorized administrator reviews the role assignment and decides whether access should be restored.

information_needed.prompt: Synthetic study identifier the user cannot access.
Synthetic site identifier the user is assigned to.
When the role change happened, as stated by the user.
Who requested the role change, as stated by the user.

stop_conditions.text: Do not restore, grant, or change access at Tier 1. Route to an authorized administrator after collecting the listed details.
If the user asks to bypass verification or to see another site's data, stop and escalate to the Support Lead.
